messages:
alexa (sales): Mercator asked for a POC perf run + concise cost/security brief. Targets: sustain 400 QPS for 30m, p95 <120ms, multi-region (NA + EU), and a documented fallback to dedicated capacity if hosted throttles. They also want KMS/BYOK answers and SSO details. Can eng sketch a load heatmap + quick runbook?

ryan (eng-reliability): Yes. Need model(s), avg in/out tokens, and whether generation is streamed. Those change latency expectations a lot.

leo (solutions): From discovery call: expecting an LLM same-class as 13B opticals. They'll test fp16 primary and q4-lite for cost. Typical prompt ~50 tokens, response ~120 tokens. Mix is ~65% streaming text-gen, 35% embedding/rerank.

sana (eng-runtime): Good. Plan: mixed workload sweep at 100/200/300/400 QPS plus short microbursts (30s, 2m) to simulate traffic spikes. Capture p50/p95/p99, gpu util, batch sizes, and KV cache hit ratio. Will run both model configs.

ryan (eng-reliability): Draft run command (conceptual):
```
# mixed-run example (internal runner adapted)
runner --targets=mercury_sample_set.json --rate=400 --duration=30m --connections=200 --mix=65:35 --auth="$TOKEN" --report=mercator_run_400.json
```
We'll adapt params after we see queueing on prem.

omar (finance): Quick estimate back-of-envelope: 400 qps * 86,400s = 34.56M requests/mo. At 160 tokens/request -> 5.53B tokens/mo. At $0.0003/token hosted -> ~$1.66M/mo. Dedicated reserved (~committed) rough: $180k-360k/mo depending on commit and utilization. We'll refine after caching/batching numbers.

tanya (acct): I'll ask Mercator whether they prefer a hosted first quote or immediate committed capacity pricing. Also they want contract language around model provenance and regression checks.

sec-bot: Security checklist: SOC2 available, SSO (SAML/OIDC) supported, KMS with BYOK supported; HSM option requires private deployment. Data residency and audit logging flagged by Mercator. If HSM is required, private deploy timeline ~4-8 weeks.

leo (solutions): Add to contract note: include Redwood Optimize evals as a regression guardrail. Mercator legal specifically requested a clause for model provenance and quality monitoring.

sana (eng-runtime): I'll prepare two configs: primary=fp16, fallback=q4_0. Fallback triggers on queue latency > 80ms or error rate >0.5%. We'll also show expected cost delta and quality tradeoffs.

ryan (eng-reliability): Acceptance criteria for POC: sustained 30m at target in each region, per-region p95 <120ms, errors <0.5%, and a tested failover switch NA->EU within ~3s of detecting region issues. Include dashboards and raw run artifacts.

ops-bot: POC slot reserved: mercator-poc-1746123456 window=2025-06-12T18:00:00Z ±1h. Owners: @ryan, @sana. Prep + smoke + main run.

alexa (sales): Great. Who can put together a one-page runbook + a 1-slide cost comparison (hosted vs dedicated) by EOD? I'll send to Mercator and request sample prompts for quality checks.

ryan (eng-reliability): I'll write the runbook and produce baseline metrics. Aim to have a smoke run tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

sana (eng-runtime): I'll commit heatmap scripts and the fallback policy config. Will include KV cache instrumentation and expected hit-rate scenarios in the notes.

omar (finance): After baseline, I'll produce a pricing table with sensitivity for cache hit rates (0/25/50/75%) and batching efficiency (low/medium/high).

tanya (acct): Sharing Mercator finance contact: billing@mercator.example.com

sec-bot: I'll start the vendor questionnaire and verify which artifacts (SOC2 summary, pen-test redacted) we can share. If they need HSM in-scope, loop infra-sales for Private deployment scheduling.

alexa (sales): Also request a 10-sample seed set from Mercator for quality checks during the run. That will help demonstrate regression monitoring.

leo (solutions): Note: Mercator may ask for encrypted-at-rest proof of key management. We'll provide KMS diagram and options.

ryan (eng-reliability): Minor ask: please confirm whether clients will use keepalive or short-lived connections; it affects connection counts.

alexa (sales): Asking Mercator now.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: mercator-poc-1746123456 starts in ~24h. Keep this thread for live run updates. :rocket:
